name: offstage
description: Keep UI, browser and macOS app work off your screen. Each command gets the least isolation that can honestly contain it: in place when it is already headless, a Linux container with Xvfb when a real window is needed, or the macOS session lane (a second, logged-in account with its own display and input) for xcodebuild, simulators and app launches. Anything that could change the machine itself is refused, not run.
